that provides a predictable and consistent interface to underlying
platform-specific implementations.

This package contains development headers for APR.

packages.name: libaprutil1-dev
packages.summary: Apache Portable Runtime Utility Library - Development Headers
packages.description:
APR is Apache's Portable Runtime Library, designed to be a support library
that provides a predictable and consistent interface to underlying

packages.name: libc6-dev
packages.summary: GNU C Library: Development Libraries and Header Files
packages.description:
Contains the symlinks, headers, and object files needed to compile
and link programs which use the standard C library.

packages.name: libc6
packages.description:
Contains the standard libraries that are used by nearly all programs on
the system. This package includes shared versions of the standard C library
and the standard math library, as well as many others.

packages.name: libcrypt-dev
packages.description:
This package contains the files needed for developing applications that
use libcrypt.

packages.name: libcrypt1
packages.description:
libxcrypt is a modern library for one-way hashing of passwords.
It supports DES, MD5, NTHASH, SUNMD5, SHA-2-256, SHA-2-512, and
bcrypt-based password hashes
It provides the traditional Unix 'crypt' and 'crypt_r' interfaces,
as well as a set of extended interfaces like 'crypt_gensalt'.

packages.name: libgcc-13-dev
packages.description:
This package contains the headers and static library files necessary for
building C programs which use libgcc, libgomp, libquadmath, libssp or libitm.

packages.name: libgcc-s1
packages.description:
Shared version of the support library, a library of internal subroutines
that GCC uses to overcome shortcomings of particular machines, or
special needs for some languages.

to support regular expressions whose syntax and semantics are as

ASCII and UTF-8 input.
